name: Sera
source:
The Curt Undine with a Hot-Cold Personality.
Sera is a stray living away from the Undine Tribe.
He is one of the rare males born into the Undine tribe that’s predominately made up of women.
He’s frequently mistaken for a woman due to his androgynous looks.
He lives alone in a lake, and rarely shows himself.
He doesn’t really understand how women feel, which leads to him occasionally irritating you.

“Hurry up and give me your hand. I can’t help worrying when I watch you.”
